text: This Service Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on 1 March 2026 between Northwind Analytics AS, Oslo, Norway (the "Supplier"), and Riverbank Logistics Ltd, Leeds, United Kingdom (the "Customer").
1.1 The Supplier shall provide hosting, monitoring and support for the data platform of the Customer, as described in this Agreement.
1.2 Support is available on business days from o8:0o to 18:00 CET. Critical incidents are answered within 2 hours.
2.1 The Customer shall pay the monthly fees in Table 1. The fees exclude VAT.
